{{DISPLAYTITLE:Roda Volcano (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA-Roda.png|right|thumb|250px|The Roda Volcano in ''Final Fantasy Tactics Advance''.]]
'''Roda Volcano''' {{J|ローダ火山|Rōda Kazan}} is a mountain location in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]''. It is one of the two locations in [[Ivalice (Tactics Advance)|Ivalice]] with flowing magma.

==Story==
When [[Marche Radiuju|Marche]] investigates the Roda Volcano he is sucked into in one of the world seams and must fight the [[Totema]] [[Ultima (Tactics Advance)|Ultima]]. The Totema herself does not appear, but instead several Ultima Crystals appear as her Avatars. After all of the Ultima Crystals are destroyed the second [[Crystal (term)|Crystal]] shatters and a vision of [[Mewt Randell|Mewt]] appears and berates Marche for attempting to destroy "his world".

Roda Volcano is also the spawn location for "Mission #102: Wyrms Awaken". It can be freed in "Mission #246: Roda Volcano" after "Mission #010: Emerald Keep" is completed.

==Missions==
*"Mission #008: Hot Awakening"
{{Quote|The Roda Volcano has been active lately. The Royal Mage Academy wants to hire researchers. No experience needed, must like heat.|Ramda, Geologist}}
*"Mission #047: Hot Recipe"
{{Quote|I need to make a super hot dish to compete with the restaurant across the street! Please get the "stuff" at Roda Volcano.|Rolana, The Chocobo's Kweh}}
*"Mission #076: Fire Sigil"
{{Quote|Marilith Serpent, Falgabird of fire and brimstone, has been seen at Roda Volcano. Your duty is clear! Godspeed.|The Mysterious Minstrel}}
*"Mission #088: The Worldwyrm"
{{Quote|The ley lines that run through Ivalice have gone awry—the World Wyrm, Ogma is come again! Defeat him or Ivalice is doomed!|Jemingo, Geomancer}}
*"Mission #246: Roda Volcano"
{{Quote|Roda Volcano's been active lately. Someone needs to go to the road at the base of the cone and clean off the chunks of lava.|Naricys, Geologist}}
